title: Actions
subtitle: Your workflows. Your runners. One place to follow every job.
emptyDescription: Build, test and ship from your repositories. Follow every job and its logs in one place.
noRunsHint: Your workflow runs and their results will appear here.
noRunnersHint: Use a connected server, including macOS, or an available temporary Cloud runner.
cancellingHint: Stopping the worker. Its slot stays reserved until execution has ended.
approvalHint: This pull request comes from a fork. Approval runs its code in a disposable Cloud VM without stored secrets or write tokens.
queuedLogs: Logs will appear when this job starts.
selectJob: Select a job to inspect its steps and logs.
name: Name
sourceHint: Repository workflows are loaded from the exact commit for each run.
secretsHint: Values are encrypted. Leave existing secrets empty to keep them.
destinationsHint: Jobs use their runs-on labels to match these runners. A Linux container cannot run macOS jobs.
forksHint: Every fork run needs approval and a disposable Cloud runner.
nativeHint: Run trusted jobs directly on the selected server. Uses its installed tools.
containerHint: Linux jobs run in Docker using the selected runner image.
trustedHint: Connected servers run trusted code only. Native jobs can access files owned by the connected user; container jobs also share this host's Docker daemon.
labelsHint: Separate labels with commas. OS and architecture come from the server.
nativeLimits: Native jobs use host resources. CPU and memory limits apply to container jobs.
onlineHint: Webhooks and schedules need this control plane to stay online. Publish it to keep workflows running while Desktop is closed.
storageHint: Use a connected storage destination for artifacts and dependency caches. Requires a published controller. Up to 1 GiB per upload, with 7 days of retention by default.
stepsPending: Steps appear when the runner starts.
manualHint: Add workflow_dispatch to this workflow to run it manually.

budget.label: Budget
budget.title: Actions budget
budget.subtitle: One prepaid balance for temporary Cloud VMs and transfer. Separate from your server plans.
budget.chargedTime: Estimates assume full CPU and RAM use, before transfer or disk I/O. Actual charges follow measured VM usage, including preparation and cleanup. Queue time uses no VM.
budget.transferPolicy: CPU time, measured memory and transfer share one balance. Workers stop when Oblien marks it exhausted; recent usage can take time to appear.
budget.artifacts: Artifacts and caches use your configured storage destination.
budget.empty: Your verified deposits will appear here.
budget.unavailable: Cloud Actions payments are temporarily unavailable.
budget.connected: Connected servers run workflows without using this Actions budget.
budget.preparing: Funds added. Preparing your Cloud runners…
budget.balanceUnavailable: Balance is temporarily unavailable. Retry to refresh it.
budget.pricingUnavailable: Live rates are unavailable. Retry before adding funds.
budget.maxParallel: {count} Cloud jobs at once, shared across all runner sizes.
budget.setupRetrying: Your funds are saved. Cloud runner setup is retrying automatically.
budget.paused: Cloud Actions is paused. Your balance is saved; contact support if it remains paused.

setup.title: Get started
setup.runnerHint: Use a connected Linux server or Mac.
setup.cloudRunnerHint: Use a temporary Cloud VM or a connected server.
setup.workflowHint: Load a repository file or paste your YAML.
setup.runHint: See each job, its logs and results.
setup.cloudHint: Every job gets a temporary Linux VM. VM usage and transfer use your separate Actions balance.

integration.setupHint: Connect a workflow, preview its jobs, then choose when and where it runs.
integration.standaloneHint: Run your own YAML on demand, on a schedule, or from an authenticated webhook. No repository required.
integration.connectRepo: Connect GitHub in Git settings to browse your repositories.
integration.noFiles: No workflows found. Choose another repository or start a standalone workflow.
integration.previewHint: Preview the jobs and their dependencies before configuring triggers and runners.
integration.fixYaml: Fix the YAML in the Workflow step to edit its triggers.
integration.projectsHint: Reuse this workflow across projects. Deployment rules are managed in each project’s Actions tab.
integration.noProjects: You can link this workflow after creating a project.
integration.linkOnCreate: The selected workflows and deployment rules are linked when this project is saved.
integration.manualHint: Run from Actions, the API, or a scheduled job. Inputs are available to your workflow.
integration.pushHint: Run for commits pushed to matching branches or paths.
integration.pullRequestHint: Run checks for pull requests. Forks require separate approval and an isolated runner.
integration.scheduleHint: Use the repository’s default branch. The control plane must stay online.
integration.webhookHint: Send an authenticated dispatch with an event type and optional JSON payload.
integration.filterHint: Use Enter or + to add a pattern. Leave empty for all.
integration.extraFilters: Additional filters are preserved. Edit the YAML to change excluded branches, paths, tags, or pull request types.
integration.commitHint: Commit these changes to the selected repository branch, or keep a copy in Openship. A commit may trigger existing GitHub automation.
integration.deployManualHint: Deploy when you choose. Workflows can still run independently.
integration.deployPushHint: New commits deploy through the normal project pipeline.
integration.deployActionsHint: Wait for every required workflow to pass for the same commit.
integration.requiredHint: Required workflows must run on every push to this project’s branch. Optional workflows may use path filters. Manual deployments remain available.
integration.noRequired: Add an enabled workflow with a push trigger from this repository.
integration.projectEmpty: Connect this project to a workflow, then choose which checks must pass before automatic deployment.
integration.wizardHint: Run CI with this repository and choose when new pushes deploy.
integration.tokenHint: Use an Openship token with permission to run this workflow. Keep the token in your caller’s secret store.
integration.jobHint: Reuse this workflow from a cron schedule, a one-time job, or a platform event.
integration.invalidValues: Variables and secrets need unique names using letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.
integration.standaloneScheduleHint: Runs while this control plane is online.
integration.anyEventType: Leave empty to accept any event type.
integration.selectedFiles: {count} selected · Already added workflows keep their settings.
integration.sharedSettings: Runner and notification settings apply to all selected files.
integration.fileLimit: Select up to 50 files per import.
integration.triggerScope: Each workflow keeps its own triggers. Edits apply only to this file.

requirements.title: Complete setup
requirements.repository: Choose a repository or use a custom workflow
requirements.source: Load a workflow or use a custom workflow
requirements.files: Select at least one workflow file
requirements.name: Add a workflow name

editor.setupHint: Build your workflow, then choose how and where it runs.
editor.canvasHint: Select a job or step to edit it. Connect jobs to set dependencies.
editor.draftHint: Changes stay in this draft until you save. Running workflows are unaffected.
editor.runsOnHint: Separate runner labels with commas. Edit complex expressions in job YAML.
editor.noDependencies: Add another job to create a dependency.
editor.connectionHint: The second job waits for the first to finish. Its condition decides whether it runs.
editor.jobYamlHint: Edit every job setting here, including matrix, services, conditions, permissions and step inputs.
editor.automaticHint: Runs use the workflow from their repository commit. Repository changes apply automatically.
editor.reviewHint: Runs keep your saved YAML. Repository changes apply only after you review and save them.
editor.repoDifferent: Your draft differs from the repository version.
editor.reviewRepositoryHint: Compare the repository with your draft. Applying it replaces this draft; save to update future runs.
editor.saveReviewHint: Commit your changes to the repository, or save them in Openship with repository updates set to Review first.

errors.cycle: This connection would create a dependency cycle. Jobs must finish before their dependents can run.
errors.missingJob: This job is no longer in the workflow. Select another job.
errors.lastJob: Keep at least one job in the workflow.
errors.referencedJob: Another job references this job’s outputs or result. Update those expressions before removing it.
errors.jobMapping: Use a valid YAML job mapping before editing the topology.

editor.listHint: Expand a job, then select a step to edit it.
editor.jobImageHint: Any compatible Linux image. Include the tools your steps and actions need.

runnerSetup.subtitle: Choose a server and a ready-to-use environment.
runnerSetup.cloudSubtitle: Choose a Cloud space and a ready-to-use job environment.
runnerSetup.selectCloudSpace: Choose a Cloud space to see compatible environments.
runnerSetup.trustedCloudSpace: Jobs share this Cloud space’s capacity. Only run trusted workflows.
runnerSetup.catalogHint: Choose an environment that works on your selected server.
runnerSetup.selectServer: Choose a server to see compatible environments.
runnerSetup.imageHint: Use an image with Node.js and Git installed.
runnerSetup.matchHint: Jobs match this runner using runs-on labels.
runnerSetup.trustedNative: Jobs run as the connected server user and can access that user’s files.
runnerSetup.trustedContainer: Jobs share this server’s Docker engine. Use trusted repositories.

ubuntu.hint: Ready-to-use Linux image with Node.js and Git.

macos.name: macOS
macos.hint: Use the tools installed on your connected Mac.

linux.name: Linux
linux.hint: Run directly with your server’s installed tools.

custom.name: Custom image
custom.hint: Bring a Docker runner image with Node.js and Git.

runnerSetup.emulationHint: Adds QEMU support to this server’s Docker engine. Emulated jobs may run more slowly.
runnerSetup.dockerAccessHint: Enable image builds inside job containers. Only run trusted workflows on this server.
runnerSetup.defaultImageHint: Each job can choose its own compatible container image.

destinations.subtitle: Where should jobs run?
destinations.existingHint: Share capacity on a connected server, including your Cloud servers. Set limits per job; server billing stays the same.
destinations.dedicatedHint: Choose a new Cloud server and plan in the server catalog, then add it as an Actions runner.
destinations.temporaryHint: A separate VM per job, removed after cleanup. Compute and transfer use your prepaid Actions balance.
destinations.cloudOnly: Temporary runners are available when this workflow is managed in Openship Cloud.
destinations.fundHint: Add prepaid Actions credit to prepare your temporary runner profiles.

controller.githubHint: Openship provides the runners; GitHub coordinates jobs, Checks, secrets and artifacts. Workflow edits are committed to the repository.
controller.labelsHint: Route jobs to these runners with runs-on: [self-hosted, openship, linux] (or macos). Jobs with other labels keep their existing destination.
controller.trust: Allow workflows in this repository to use these runners. Anyone who can change its workflow files can execute code on these destinations and use their Actions budget.
controller.liveLogs: Job and step status updates here. Live output is available in GitHub until this job finishes.

completion.githubChecksHint: Results appear on commits and pull requests.
completion.appChecksHint: Each job publishes a Check on this repository.
completion.standaloneChecksHint: Job and step results stay in Openship.
completion.requiredChecksHint: Choose which workflows must pass in the project's Deployment automation tab.
completion.notificationsHint: Send this workflow’s results to your notification channels.
completion.noChannels: Add a channel to receive workflow results.
completion.teamChannels: {count} channels configured by another member are preserved.
completion.accountPreferences: Account-wide Actions notifications also apply. Overlapping rules share the same notification.
completion.verifyHint: Send a test message to verify this channel before using it.
completion.verifyFailed: The channel could not be verified. Try again.

connectionHints.not_connected: Connect GitHub to run this repository’s workflows and report results.
connectionHints.app_required: Install a GitHub App with Checks write access to publish results.
connectionHints.access_required: Review your GitHub connection and this repository’s permissions.
connectionHints.actions_disabled: Enable GitHub Actions for this repository.

access.title: Access & approvals
access.hint: Choose who may use these destinations and when a run needs approval.
access.usersHint: Add usernames. Access is saved against verified account IDs, so a renamed account cannot give someone else permission.
access.requiredHint: An Openship administrator reviews the commit, attempt and destinations before a runner is allocated.
access.automaticHint: Eligible users and authorized schedules can start runs without an extra approval.
access.automaticGitHubHint: Eligible users can run without an Openship approval. GitHub's repository and environment protection rules still apply.
access.forkHint: Only eligible users may request these runs. Forks always require approval and never run on connected servers.
access.needIsolated: Add a disposable Cloud runner to allow fork runs.
access.githubHint: Review fork and environment approvals in GitHub. Those rules do not require approval for every collaborator push.
access.reviewHint: Approve commit {commit}, attempt {attempt}, requested by {actor}, for the destinations below.
access.budget: Cloud execution uses the selected runner’s prepaid Actions balance.

reasons.policy_missing: Review this workflow’s access settings before using its runners.
reasons.identity_unavailable: The account that requested this run could not be verified. Reconnect GitHub and refresh the workflow.
reasons.actor_not_allowed: The account that requested or retried this run is not allowed by this workflow’s access policy.
reasons.fork_disabled: Fork runs are blocked by this workflow’s access policy.
reasons.approval_required: This commit and attempt need an administrator’s approval.
reasons.destinations_changed: No allowed destination is available. Review the selected runners and refresh this run.

access.destinationsUnavailable: Some destinations could not be loaded. Refresh this review or update the workflow's runners before approving.
access.reviewerRequired: An administrator with access to these destinations must approve this run.

runnerDetails.imageHint: Jobs can use a different Linux container image in Job settings.
runnerDetails.labelsHint: Labels route jobs here; they do not change the image or installed tools.

runView.noStepLogs: No output recorded for this step.
runView.approvalClosed: This run is no longer waiting for approval.
